summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a daily open-market purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at an average price of 107.6601 pence per share, as part of its existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The purchases were executed by Goldman Sachs International as broker, and the shares will be cancelled. This is a routine capital return via an issuer buyback, not a tender offer or special event. The filing confirms ongoing execution of the pre-announced programme. There are no premium, advisor, or risk-arb angles; monitoring is limited to programme pace and volume.
